identity: ONE original bearded infantry soldier, the Milestone Buckler, facing screen right in elevated three-quarter view. Keep his short dark brown hair and beard, the cream scarf, the rust-red quilted tunic, the steel shoulder plates, the navy trousers, the brown gloves and boots and the leather belt pouches. Exactly two arms, two hands and two legs. The screen-RIGHT forearm carries ONE rigid rectangular navy wooden shield with a brass rim, a vertical brass stripe and a round boss; the screen-LEFT hand grips ONE short wooden spear with one steel leaf-shaped head, held low and pointing diagonally down toward screen left. Preserve the shield, the spear and the proportions.
plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full head, the whole spear with its tip, the whole shield, limbs and boots within frame. The background is perfectly flat saturated BLUE throughout, no gradients or changes of hue. The blue background stays the same flat saturated blue in every frame and never darkens, flashes or changes colour. No scenery, floor shadow, camera motion, zoom, additional weapons, sparks, motion trails, particles or extra limbs. Articulate joints naturally with physical planted-foot support; the spear stays rigid at its original length and the shield never morphs.

idle_h3_v1.action: A steady, watchful idle that loops. He breathes, the shoulders rise and fall, the spear tip dips and lifts a little in the low hand, the shield settles on the arm, his head turns slightly to scan and the scarf stirs, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no attack.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE spear thrust toward screen right. He raises the spear level to waist height and draws it back as the knees bend, then lunges forward and drives it straight out beside the shield to full reach at screen right, draws back and lowers the spear to its low diagonal ready position in the original stance. One thrust only; no sparks or effect at contact.

hit_h3_v1.action: He starts rocked back in a flinch and recovers from it. His head and shoulders are thrown back, the shield swings out and the knees flex while both hands keep hold of the spear and the shield, then he steadies on both boots and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Crouch low behind the shield, pulling it in front of the body with the head ducked behind its rim and the spear held low, then hold the braced guard on both planted boots. No attack and no return to the relaxed stance.
